process_wiki_extractor_output: run the script to parse WikiExtractor XML output and dump a pickle file of parsed document objects
parse_wiki_xml_documents: parse a WikiExtractor XML file into a dictionary keyed by document id and title tuples
extract_doc_attributes: extract document url, lines, and token count from WikiExtractor XML doc tags using xml.etree.ElementTree
count_tokens_in_docs: count the number of tokens in each WikiExtractor document by joining and splitting lines on spaces
pickle_wiki_docs: dump the parsed WikiExtractor documents dictionary to a pickle file using protocol 4
